seedSequence: Math.imul(i, 0x9e3779b1) >>> 0, i=0..1999 (loot-plan seed, not combat seed)

methodology.unitValue: Existing cores wallet, first-rank equivalent; not physical item count
methodology.oldZeroCounter: floor(prefixNormalCount/20) + old elite and boss awards; excludes clear bonus until wave20
methodology.oldSteadyCarry: prefixNormalCount/20 + old elite and boss awards; long-run per-loop income with normal remainder carried across attempts
methodology.newExpected: Empirical mean over 2000 unchanged shipped plans per floor; approximate sampling CI in JSON
methodology.farmAttempts: Only currency deficit modeled. New expected attempts uses empirical prefix PMF and independent-attempt renewal equation. Old attempts includes exact carried normal remainder starting at zero. Does not include combat time, HP loss, death, healing, travel, realm, book ownership or SP gates.
methodology.fullClear: Repeat includes 5*(floor-1); first clear additionally +10; clean path starts at cores20 and carries old remainder between floors.
methodology.firstMonster: First authored entity, not a guarantee of the first killed entity. Same-archetype pooled floor rate is reported separately.

completionAudit.note: Concurrent edits outside this read-only subtask changed TowerGrowth.js after sampling; the book/research/evolution prices and requirements used here were re-imported and compared exactly. No runtime files or existing reports were written by this task.

assessment.verdict: Material reward-timing and retreat-farming change; bounded full-floor totals do not imply unchanged balance.
assessment.earlyRetreat: Wave3 income is 2.55–3.85x legacy steady carried-counter income; wave19 retains more of repeat-clear reward. No per-minute dominance claim without timing measurements.
assessment.permanentProgression: Material acceleration for currency-starved repeat/failed/retreated runs after clear/realm/prerequisite/SP gates. No gate bypass or unlimited research.
assessment.cleanFirstPass: Starting wallet20 and the lower bounds already fund all unlocked ordinary books and research at floors1/2/3/6/9, plus one evolution at floor6/9 if other requirements are met and no other spending. This clean first-pass path does not gain a newly removed currency bottleneck.
assessment.sameArchetype: Rank/value are archetype-specific; base and effective probabilities are floor-specific and conditioned.
assessment.recommendation: Do not certify overall balance unchanged. If temporal neutrality is mandatory, separately design milestone/prefix reward targets and test retreat purchase thresholds. No rule changes in this report.
assessment.constraintConflict: Old rank3 boss credit20 versus at most3 now, and rank7 old40 versus at most7 now, cannot be preserved with one matching-rank linear-value core and no compensating credit. Deferring ordinary excess to elite/Boss milestones or compensating in the existing wallet would require changing the immediate-credit/settlement contract.
limitations: 2000 seeds per floor, not all uint32 seeds.
No combat, time, health, healing or permanent-save simulation.
Expected farming attempts use an independent-cycle empirical-PMF currency model; actual seed sequences and play outcomes may differ.
First authored entity is not necessarily first killed.

rejectionReason: Full-floor means hid 2.55–3.85x first-three-wave income and materially stronger retreat farming. Historical findings retained; not current acceptance evidence.
